intro: Visa-free for 60 days, an active infrastructure for Russian speakers and affordable prices. Istanbul and Antalya are the main hubs; Alanya is for winterers.
climate: Mediterranean on the coast (mild winters around +10), continental inland (cold in winter), subtropical in Antalya (a warm winter).
mentality: Hospitable and open people, a tea-drinking culture and a historically friendly attitude towards Russia.
language_note: Turkish is the official language and tricky for Russian speakers. English is used in tourist areas, Russian in Alanya and Antalya.
visa_note: Visa-free for 60 days. A residence permit via ikamet — tourist, work or family. Buying property from $200,000 grants an investment ikamet.
